The AsRock BC-250 is one of the craziest Gaming PCs you can build in 2026. It's not sleek. It's not fast. It's not power efficient. It's not stable. But it's some of the most fun I've had with PC hardware in the last year, and I've put together a list of Do's and Don't's for putting one together yourself. These builds are NOT for everyone, and certainly not for those looking for a turnkey Gaming PC, but for those adventurous enough, the BC-250 is definitely worth the effort.
